Use a single tap in the center for gestures (like play/pause) instead of a double tap.

You can bind custom actions to these gestures in input.conf using the following key codes:

Left: MBTN_LEFT_DBL
Center: MBTN_MID_DBL
Right: MBTN_RIGHT_DBL

You can bind custom actions to media controls in input.conf using the following key codes:

Previous: PREV
Play/Pause: PLAYPAUSE
Next: NEXT

Fixes the purple/green tint on Dolby Vision Profile 5 by decoding only those titles in software so gpu-next can apply the DV metadata. All other titles keep hardware decoding. Requires gpu-next and a decoder that is not zero-copy.
Requires gpu-next and a non-zero-copy decoder
